paragraphs.text: Intet (IHN-tet ), the Dreamer , is a female primeval dragon on Dominaria in an alternate timeline.

Intet is a female primeval dragon from Dominaria that was seen during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . She is a large blue-scaled dragon with red-green colored wings and fins along her neck, back, and tail. She wears golden jewelry, gems around her neck, and golden bands and rings on her front claws and wing joints.
The four other alternate timeline primeval dragons are Numot , Oros , Teneb and Vorosh .
